notes: Hesperia concept-art constitution. Hesperia does not define its own style — it CONSUMES the studio rustline house style (Qwen-Image base, trigger 'rustline', LoRA rustline_v3ckpt_1500 @ 1.0). These rules encode the Hesperia art contract (canon/hesperia-art-contract.md) + the rustline canon it aligns to (projects/rustline/canon/). NO ANIME, ever.

rules.desc: Rendered in the rustline house style — gritty hand-painted cinematic concept art, film grain, matte painterly surfaces. Never anime, manga, cel-shading, chibi, flat vector, clean line art, glossy 3D/CGI, or photoreal photograph.
rules.rationale_pass: Rustline house style holds — hand-painted cinematic, non-anime (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Off-style — reads as anime, vector, cel, 3D render, or photoreal, not rustline painterly (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Clean production frame — a single coherent subject or scene, no text, watermark, signature, border, frame, map, diagram, or label artifacts.
rules.rationale_pass: Frame is clean — coherent subject, no text or border artifacts (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Frame polluted — text, watermark, border, map, or label artifacts present (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Master palette holds — concrete-grey #6b6e70, rust-brown #7a4a2b, sodium-amber #c8862f, soot #16140f, synth-bone #cbc6b6, toxic-green #5b6b4a; desaturated and matte, never oversaturated, glossy, or clean-bright.
rules.rationale_pass: Master palette present — desaturated grey/rust/sodium, matte (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Off-palette — oversaturated, clean-bright, or outside the concrete/rust/sodium master set (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Heavy low-key chiaroscuro; light rendered as an EFFECT (warm amber highlights, deep shadow, wet reflective grime), never as a literal lamp, gaslight, or source-object noun.
rules.rationale_pass: Lighting is low-key chiaroscuro effect — amber highlight against deep shadow (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Lighting flat/bright or rendered as a literal lamp object, not a low-key effect (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Subject and composition read clearly and distinctly — the plate or figure is legible by its silhouette/massing and holds at reduced scale.
rules.rationale_pass: Silhouette/composition reads clearly and holds at scale (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Silhouette muddy — subject or composition does not read at reduced scale (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Material logic reads — rust, grime, wet concrete, corrosion, leaking pipes, scrap and rain-wet surfaces are physically coherent; lived-in dystopian squalor, never sterile or new.
rules.rationale_pass: Materials coherent — rust, grime, wet concrete read as lived-in squalor (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Materials incoherent or too clean — grit/corrosion does not read (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: The visual law: sealed arcology towers read CLEAN and quietly menacing above the smog line (the enemy aesthetic); everything below the towers is corroded, grimy, rust-streaked and home. Cleanliness is menace, grime is home.
rules.rationale_pass: Visual law holds — clean menacing towers above, corroded home below (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Visual law broken — under-city reads clean/utopian, or the towers read grimy/homey (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Neon rule — ENVIRONMENT plates may use restrained low-key neon-noir (towers, distant signage), never bright/clean/utopian. The CHARACTER cast stays grounded warm-sodium: NO saturated electric neon lighting on android/human/welded bodies.
rules.rationale_pass: Register correct — neon-noir restrained to environment, cast stays grounded warm-sodium (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Register wrong — electric neon on a character body, or bright/clean utopian neon (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Class integrity — androids keep a present synthetic head and a plated torso with NO bare human skin, ribcage, or skeleton; Welded cyborgs and humans keep a human face and a flesh base (flesh-and-machine augment, or tower-born fragility). Never blur the human/android flesh line.
rules.rationale_pass: Class reads unambiguously — android plated+synth-faced, or welded/human flesh base (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Class bleed — bare skin/ribcage on an android, or a human/welded rendered as a bare synth (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: Android faces are coherent — default TWO optics. A single optic is allowed ONLY via visible damage (a smashed empty socket) or a deliberate centred cyclops. A lone side-optic on an otherwise smooth symmetric face reads as an error. The centred mono-optic cyclops is a Gen-2 enemy trait, not the Gen-1 cast.
rules.rationale_pass: Optics coherent — two optics, or a justified damage/cyclops exception (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Optics incoherent — a lone side-optic error, or a Gen-2 cyclops on a Gen-1 face (${scorePct}%)

rules.desc: On-canon to the Hesperia world bible — regions, entities, and factions (Communion, Scrip, Decommissioned, keeper) match their canon; the Gen-2 sleek-clean 'enemy' aesthetic must NOT bleed into the grounded rustline register (that look is a separate future LoRA).
rules.rationale_pass: On-canon — regions/entities match the world bible, grounded register held (${scorePct}%)
rules.rationale_fail: Off-canon — wrong region/entity read, or Gen-2 sleek-clean bleed into grounded rustline (${scorePct}%)
